Title: Changes to Visual Studio Online Professional and Advanced user plans

Body.Content: There is a minor change to the previously announced updates for Visual Studio Team Services (formerly Visual Studio Online) user plans. Visual Studio Online Professional plans weren’t automatically converted to the new Visual Studio Professional monthly subscription on February 1, 2016. You can manually convert your user plan to the Visual Studio Professional monthly subscription at any point since it provides access to an unlimited number of Visual Studio Team Services accounts. For information about how to do this, please see Manage users and assign access to your Visual Studio Team Services account. For other features released in December 2015, please visit our Custom work item fields and more webpage.
